snippet.title: The 7th Guest Remake Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
1993 adventure game classic The 7th Guest is back! A full-blown remake of this beloved mystery-puzzle game — featuring live-action video performances — is coming soon to PC and consoles.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4491360/The_7th_Guest_Remake

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
